verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has no general event-driven rules engine. It does document narrow, domain-specific automation: user-defined bucket lifecycle policies that automatically run actions such as Expiration and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload, Cluster Autoscaler scaling of Node Pools in response to GPU/CPU/memory demand, and Grafana alerts for monitoring. Missing for 10: a general rule/trigger system for arbitrary platform events, event-to-action automation beyond storage lifecycle and autoscaling, outbound event hooks, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
